dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit sharp, irregular perimeters of high-intensity light-gray pixels. These perimeters define a high-contrast boundary between the dark-intensity exterior coat and a similarly dark-intensity interior core, creating a clear ring-like gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity pixels localized primarily on the posterior-lateral region. These features lack an internal gradient and appear as distinct, isolated points between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent mid-dorsal annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle. A secondary spatial relationship is formed by a series of four smaller high-intensity blobs arranged in a roughly linear-curved sequence toward the posterior-dorsal terminus.
